candidate.question: In 1987, the Commonwealth of Nations was made up of

options.B: Britain and some of her former colonies
options.C: France and some of her former colonies

candidate.explanation: In 1987, the Commonwealth brought together Britain and independent countries with historical links to the British Empire. Its members cooperated as equal states; membership did not mean that Britain governed them.
